newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Abigroup soars on newspaper article.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Abigroup soars on newspaper article.

text.p: The shares of construction company Abigroup Ltd have risen sharply on light volume on Monday following a newspaper article on Sunday which said the company was trading at a lower price/earnings ratio than its peers.
At 11.20 a.m. (0020 GMT), Abigroup shares were 66 cents higher at A$4.11 on turnover of 104,800 shares.
"The paper article has obviously aroused quite a bit of buying interest in the stock," a Sydney-based dealer said.
The report, in Saturday's edition of the Sydney Morning Herald Newspaper, said the company could well be the growth story of 1996.

"Abigroup still remains a mystery to many investors, and that may be one reason it is trading at a lower price/earnings ratio than its peers such as Leighton Holdings Ltd, Henry Walker Group Ltd, Eltin Ltd and McMahon Holdings Ltd," the newspaper article said.
Abigroup's major project is the construction of the M2 motorway in north-west Sydney.
